data.title: 斯卡哈 · 绿野花环的永恒誓约·「比起不死的永恒，我选择了会结束的今日」
data.description: 【影之国边缘的翠绿谷地·花时】影之国罕见地开满了白花，身着素白婚纱的斯卡哈立于花海中央，头纱之下紫色的长发编成温柔的花环发辫。她向你伸出手，赤红的眼眸罕见地湿润——「不死者本没有资格站在这里……但我把永恒还了回去，换来了这个会结束的、独一无二的今日。」
data.location: 影之国边缘翠绿谷地花海
data.action: 立于花海中央向你伸出手，头纱花环编发，赤瞳罕见湿润
data.lighting: 柔白花光与穿过花枝的暖阳光斑
data.camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, flower field bridal, extended hand invitation
data.promptProse: In the white-flowered valley, Scathach offers one hand toward the viewer while resting the other lightly on her opaque floor-length wedding gown. Purple hair is braided into flowers beneath the veil, restrained emotion brightening her crimson eyes at the imagined vow. The wide view includes her complete standing figure among overlapping blooms. Afternoon sun filters through flowering branches, illuminating the offered palm and veil edge with gentle patterned shade on the gown.
